proposal.title: 11. SSG General Ledger — Align networking, recovery pilots and independent maintenance handover
proposal.reason: Replace the former BPI scenario with the author-requested independent SSG General Ledger partnership. Use the confirmed story dates: agreement 1977-07-28, team/development 1977-08-12, vanilla CP/M/CBASIC release 1978-01-15 and joint AION C/General Ledger Aurelia launch on the morning of 1978-06-06. SSG retains application ownership and sales; AION funds bounded porting and later networking work, not an equity investment. Preserve stable legacy record IDs for reference and review continuity; displayed identities and product scope are SSG General Ledger. Exact original GL/runtime revisions and speed ratios remain unverified. See review_evidence/ssg-general-ledger for source distinctions, scope and validation.

before.title: International Logix-compatible launch — five manufacturers and Aion Tech UK
before.description: Accepted scenario: coordinated US, West German, French and Spanish premieres by North Star, Vector Graphic, SKS, SMT Goupil and EINA, plus Aion Tech UK retail introduction of Aurelia and Artemis. Release the initial qualified Aurelia/Artemis ranges and local platform editions. Live multi-brand document exchange, WordStar/dBASE on the assumed qualified licensed editions, Abacus/Pulse, peripheral compatibility and Team Edition demonstrations. Show BPI only on separately licensed and locally qualified configurations. Dealers can complete ranges with Logix or third-party products. Availability is configuration-specific; SGS full-portfolio qualification is not claimed. No shipment quantities are assigned by this event.

inputs.description: Product and production preparation completed during 1981 within the clone and second-source programme provides the qualified initial manufacturer ranges, manufacturing arrangements and launch stock. The wider programme, including SGS qualification, continues after this launch.
Preceding work supporting this event: Common-core localisation and third-party licensing.

Dealer, service and Academy preparation available by launch supplies trained local instructors, installers and repair staff, spare-stock arrangements and customer escalation for the supported initial configurations. The readiness programme continues through 31 March 1982; this input does not claim that all of its work is complete at launch.

before.title: Artemis Networking development and launch
before.description: Develop the Artemis networking and server platform from 12 July 1980 through the NCC launch campaign and its recovery pilots ending on 30 June 1981. The campaign presents the platform in May and coordinates dealer/BPI qualification follow-up; commercial shipments remain conditional.

inputs.description: The existing Artemis and AIONix platform supplies the hardware and operating-system foundation for network development.

steps.description: Develop and integrate TCP/IP networking, AIONix server services and supported Aurelia/Artemis network upgrades.
Integrate the client-server application generation and prepare configuration-specific authentication, locking, backup and crash-recovery tests.
Present the networked business-computing platform, Artemis PRO and supported upgrades at NCC, and carry the campaign through its dealer/BPI recovery pilots.
Coordinate the marketing campaign: Networked business-computing platform presented.

outcomes.description: The networking and server platform is presented at NCC and reaches multi-client recovery pilots during campaign follow-up. Configuration-specific results gate server sales and July shipments; the programme does not establish unrestricted availability or forecast revenue from unpriced larger storage.

The programme reaches configuration-specific multi-client recovery pilots for the networking/server platform and BPI client/server implementations. Their results gate sales and shipments; completion of every qualification is not inferred.

The CP/M Aurelia networking edition supplies the TCP/IP stack, LogixLAN adapter driver, network configuration tools and BPI client networking API for supported Aurelia and Aurelia+ upgrades. Availability remains subject to configuration-specific qualification and the programme’s shipment gates.

after.title: Artemis Networking development and launch

inputs.description: The existing Artemis and AIONix platform supplies the hardware and operating-system foundation for network development.

steps.description: Develop and integrate TCP/IP networking, AIONix server services and supported Aurelia/Artemis network upgrades.

Integrate the SSG General Ledger client/server adaptation, preserving ledger correctness and bounded clients. Prepare configuration-specific authentication, locking, durable posting, duplicate-retry, backup and crash-recovery tests.
Present the networked business-computing platform, Artemis PRO and supported upgrades at NCC, and carry the campaign through its dealer/SSG recovery pilots.
Coordinate the marketing campaign: Networked business-computing platform presented.

At acceptance of the separately scoped SSG networking phase, hand over source, reproducible builds, regression/recovery tests and maintainer training. End the special application-development assignment after agreed defect correction; SSG alone owns future product development and specialist support.

The CP/M Aurelia networking edition supplies the TCP/IP stack, LogixLAN adapter driver, network configuration tools and SSG client networking API for supported Aurelia and Aurelia+ upgrades. Availability remains subject to configuration-specific qualification and the programme’s shipment gates.
